## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Risk and compatibility

- [ ] No public API, configuration, deployment, or persisted-data contract changes
- [ ] Security implications reviewed
- [ ] Migration and rollback documented when required
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for notable changes

## Verification

- [ ] Frontend quality checks
- [ ] Seeder tests and vet
- [ ] Compose/preflight validation
- [ ] Relevant manual or integration scenario
